description: A well-ordered relation admits no sequence \(a_i\) with \(a_{i+1}<a_i\) at every natural-number index.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.wellOrdered_no_descent.{u} {M : Type u} {r : M → M → Prop}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.WellOrdered r) (a : ℕ → M) : ¬∀ (i : ℕ), r (a (i + 1)) (a i)
